args.title: Juniper Labware: Freight pricing this quarter — summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Juniper Labware newsletter, its linked article (blog.juniper.example/2026/freight), and the article's companion piece (insights.juniper.example/freight/companion):

- Freight spot rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
